slides.s: Engineering Leader | 21 Years Driving Software, DevOps & AI-Enabled Transformation
slides.n: Welcome to {name}'s professional journey. With 21 years of progressive experience and 8 years in engineering management, {he} has built and led high-performing teams across software development, testing, DevOps, and AI-driven engineering transformation.

items: F5 Innovation India · Jul2025-Sep2026 — Led a 10-member team on BIGIP control plane authentication, provisioning and security hardening; drove 7-8 agentic AI agents for CVE remediation and reduced upgrade time by ~90%.

Cisco Systems India · Mar2020-Jul2025 — Led Webex developer experience team, architecting AWS-hosted distributed services integrating Webex Calling with Microsoft Teams; drove AI-based automated code generation for Webex SDKs.

Cisco Systems India · Apr2018-Feb2020 — Led Kubernetes-native CI/CD release engineering using Jenkins, Docker, OpenStack; managed 10+ major and 30+ minor product releases and led Cisco Expressway VoIP gateway development.

Cisco Systems India · Apr2008-Feb2018 — Owned functional, regression and automation testing for Cisco Call Manager and Expressway, handling VoIP/SIP conformance and driving automation coverage toward 100%.
Verizon India · May2007-Mar2008 — Performed end-to-end call-flow functional and regression testing for IP-converged contact center solutions covering IVR, call routing and PSTN/VoIP integration.
slides.n: {His} career spans over two decades, evolving from hands-on QA and testing roles into engineering leadership. Along the way, {he} led major initiatives in VoIP systems, cloud-distributed architectures, CI/CD platforms, and most recently, agentic AI-driven engineering transformation at F5.

items: AI & GenAI (RAG, LangChain, Agentic AI, LLMs)
slides.n: {His} technical foundation is broad — spanning programming, cloud-native DevOps, and deep networking protocol expertise — layered with strong leadership skills and hands-on experience applying generative AI to real engineering problems.

{His} impact is measurable — from cutting product upgrade time by roughly 90%, to resolving over 100 long-standing customer defects and CVEs, and building 7 to 8 AI agents that automate issue resolution and remediation.

{His} academic path grounds {his} technical leadership — from an engineering degree in Electronics and Communication to a PMP certification, and more recently, a postgraduate program in Artificial Intelligence from the University of Texas at Austin.

slides.s: Mayur Saxena — Engineering Leadership, AI Innovation, and Delivery Excellence
slides.n: That concludes {name}'s journey — a career built on technical depth, leadership, and a passion for driving AI-enabled transformation in engineering. Thank you for taking the time to learn about {his} story.
